about: A small composed brief about the invented town of Millbrook. Item 1 is stated by its sources, item 2 takes a step beyond them, item 3 is contradicted by its source, item 4 cites a source that does not exist, and item 5 has a sentence that attributes to its source more than the source says (an attribution overclaim).

items.insight: Millbrook's library will stay open until 9 p.m. on weekdays from March.
items.why_it_matters: The extension is funded for one year, so a review of visitor numbers decides whether it lasts.
detail: Evening visits were already the busiest part of the day.

items.insight: Longer hours are likely to lift library visits further.
items.why_it_matters: If the reading room was already full in the evening, the extra hours meet demand rather than create it.
detail: Weekend demand is even stronger than evening demand.
